```{r}
#| label: load-packages

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor) # to clean column names
```

```{r}
#| label: import-data

colonize_data <- read.csv("data/coldata110.csv")
colonize_data <- colonize_data %>%
  clean_names() #standardizes column name format (lowercase, _ as seperator)

wage_data <- read.csv("data/const_wage_data.csv")
wage_data <- wage_data %>%
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
#| label: colonize-data-exploration

dim(colonize_data)

summary(colonize_data)

```

```{r}
#| label: wage-data-exploration

dim(wage_data)

summary(wage_data)

wage_data %>%
  distinct(classif1_label)

wage_data %>%
  distinct(classif2_label)
```

```{r}
#| label: colonize-data-clean
```

```{r}
#| label: wage-data-clean
wage_data_1 <- wage_data %>%
  filter(sex_label == "Total") %>%
  filter(classif1_label == "ILO sector: Construction") %>%
  filter(classif2_label == "Currency: 2021 PPP $")

wage_data_1 %>%
  distinct(ref_area_label, time) %>%
  count() # Equal to obs count in wage_data_1: there is now only 1 obs per
          # nation-year combonation


```
